content:
**Thirst Quencher** is an Endurance-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

It is exclusive to human players and cannot be equipped by ghoul players.

Increases maximum Action Points while not diseased, based on current Endurance.

| ![FO76 thirst quencher perk bonus](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/fallout/images/e/e2/FO76_thirst_quencher_perk_bonus.png) | | 
| | Endurance | Max AP | 
| | 1 | +7 | 
| | 15 | +78 | 
| | 30 | +125 | 
| | 60 | +175 | 
| | 100 | +200 | 

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 1 | Increased Max AP based on END while not diseased. | 002BA547 | 

The perk was reduced from 3 ranks to 1 in Update 54. Here are the previous ranks:

| Rank | Description | Editor ID | Form ID | 
| 1 | Drinking any liquid has a 30% reduced chance to cause Disease. | ThirstQuencher01 | 002BA547 | 
| 2 | Drinking any liquid has a 60% reduced chance to cause Disease. | ThirstQuencher02 | 002BA561 | 
| 3 | Drinking any liquid has a 90% reduced chance to cause Disease. | ThirstQuencher03 | 002BA562 |
